purpose: y2s63: Nord2Metal only (y2s62 with the thumbnails back ON THE GPU). An odd-sized two-plane YCbCr surface (format 500) is imported in place at the next EVEN size (e.g. 376x668 over the surface's own rows and chroma offset, when that fits its memory: IOSurface's own padding), converted on the GPU into an even-sized RGB picture and its odd-sized part GPU-copied into the texture ('SURF ycbcr-odd ...' with per-use queue cost; 'SURF odd-check ... gpu= cpu= match|DIFFER' for the first 6). CPU only as fallback: /var/db/nord2-metal/no-gpu-ycbcr-odd (odd sizes) or photos-ycbcr-cpu (all of MobileSlideShow); y2s62's MobileSlideShow-thumbnail CPU default removed. The vt21 cache flush is now off by default (on with /var/db/nord2-metal/ycbcr-flush). Odd-sized format 540 (VideoToolbox sources) stays on the raw CPU copy of y2s62. Backup Nord2Metal.pre-vt23; undo: guest-vt23-undo.sh (back to y2s62-vt22).
